rules.title: Treated, controlled blood pressure charges the treatment band only
rules.statement: Where blood pressure is treated and the current reading is at or below 145/90, charge the treatment debit of 25 only. Do not add the reading band on top.
rules.markup_sentence: Blood pressure that is treated and controlled carries the treatment charge only; the reading is not charged on top.

rules.title: Private aviation under a hundred hours a year is a flat extra, never a rating
rules.statement: A private pilot flying fewer than 100 hours a year takes a flat extra of $2.50 per $1,000 and no rating debits. Private aviation at that level is never declined.
rules.markup_sentence: Private aviation at a modest number of hours a year takes a flat extra rather than rating debits, and is never declined for the flying alone.

rules.title: Family-history debits lapse once the applicant is older than the qualifying age
rules.statement: Family-history debits are dropped entirely once the applicant is over 60.
rules.markup_sentence: Family-history debits are dropped once the applicant is older than the family-history qualifying age.

rules.title: Three or more cardiac risk factors together carry an interaction charge
rules.statement: When three or more of these appear together - a blood pressure debit, a lipid debit, an A1c debit, BMI of 31 or above, current tobacco use, or a charged family history of cardiac disease - add a further 25 debits as an interaction charge.
rules.markup_sentence: Several cardiac risk factors appearing together carry an interaction charge on top of the individual debits.

rules.title: Late-onset type 2 diabetes with a controlled A1c earns a credit
rules.statement: Type 2 diabetes first diagnosed after age 45 with an A1c below 7.0 earns a credit of 25 debits, floored at zero.
rules.markup_sentence: Adult-onset diabetes first diagnosed in later middle age, with the A1c well controlled, earns a credit against the debits.

rules.title: Hazardous occupation plus hazardous avocation takes an exclusion rider
rules.statement: An occupation in class C combined with a hazardous avocation takes an exclusion rider for the avocation rather than a flat extra or avocation debits.
rules.markup_sentence: A hazardous occupation combined with a hazardous avocation takes an exclusion rider for the avocation, not a flat extra and not debits.

rules.title: Where cholesterol and the ratio disagree, the ratio governs
rules.statement: Where the total cholesterol band and the ratio band disagree, the ratio governs. Charge the ratio band only.
rules.markup_sentence: Where the total cholesterol band and the ratio band disagree, the ratio governs; the cholesterol band is not charged.

rules.title: A large face amount at a high multiple of income is postponed
rules.statement: A face amount above $1,000,000 at more than 20 times income is postponed for financial evidence, not rated.
rules.markup_sentence: A large face amount at a high multiple of income is postponed for financial evidence rather than rated.

rules.title: Recent weight loss is added back at half before the build band is read
rules.statement: Weight lost in the past 12 months is added back at half before the build band is read.
rules.markup_sentence: Weight lost in the past year is added back at half before the build band is read.

rules.title: A recent DUI is a postpone, not a rating
rules.statement: A DUI within the last 3 years is a postpone, not a rating.
rules.markup_sentence: A recent DUI is postponed, not rated.

rules.title: Sleep apnea on documented CPAP compliance carries no debit
rules.statement: Where CPAP compliance is documented, sleep apnea carries no debit at all - the 50 does not apply.
rules.markup_sentence: Sleep apnea with documented CPAP compliance carries no debit.

rules.title: Mildly elevated liver enzymes with no alcohol history carry no debit
rules.statement: Elevated liver enzymes below twice the upper limit of normal, with no alcohol history, carry no debit.
rules.markup_sentence: Mildly elevated liver enzymes with no alcohol history carry no debit.

rules.title: Two relatives with the same cancer break the family-history cap
rules.statement: Two first-degree relatives with the same cancer before 60 add a further 25 debits on top of the family-history cap.
rules.markup_sentence: Where two first-degree relatives have had the same cancer young, the family-history cap does not hold and a further charge applies.

rules.title: Deep or overhead-environment scuba takes a flat extra
rules.statement: Scuba to a depth greater than 100 feet, or any cave or wreck penetration, takes a flat extra of $5.00 per $1,000 regardless of the number of dives, and no scuba depth debit.
rules.markup_sentence: Scuba beyond recreational depth, or any cave or wreck penetration, takes a flat extra regardless of how often the applicant dives.
